items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Papa Sellers there, that was the Tuxedo Brass Band. And they had a wonderful band.

ctx.x: But mostly we just called it the Gut Bucket Band. That was the second line, you see. Now, you see, way up in the front when they had them big parades, well, Papa Sellers there, that was the Tuxedo Brass Band. And they had a wonderful band. They played all them marches. But man, we was back there, Tunk, and they used to call that the Tunk back there. And we was just, there were all the second lines there, right back there. Right behind the band, by our band. Sometimes it was better, back, better brass band.…
Well, would they have battles between the different musicians in that one brass band, you know, contests like?
